summary: Owned units s0133–s0154 are undated anecdote and reception prose except the explicit 母喪 of Wang Shu’s mother and Wang Xizhi’s qualitative 暮年 / 年在桑榆. The goose, disciple, and fan encounters, and the Yu Yi / Xi Yin / Yu Liang letters, remain undated personal attestations; Zhong Yao and Zhang Zhi appear only as later retrospective comparisons and must not feed life dates or active hints. The AD 354 chain is the defect. Chapter 80 never writes 永和十年: s0153 dates the mother’s death only as 以母喪居郡境, and s0156 says only 及述為揚州刺史. claim-387’s onOrBefore AD 354 therefore does not belong to the mother’s own event; that year is the conventional label of Wang Shu’s later Yang appointment, which this chapter leaves undated. Context rows that attach 永和十年 to s0156 are previous-model assertions, not independent evidence. 晉書穆帝紀 does date that appointment to 永和十年二月, 王述傳 adds 服闋 before it, and 東晉穆帝永和十年 is the conventional AD 354 year, but those witnesses were not cited on the death claim and must not be silently turned into a chapter-internal Gregorian endpoint or an active hint. hints-p049 AD 354 and the p049/p050 person records inherit the same unsupported year. Empty hints on p040–p048 and p050 match the owned narrative. No omitted births or numerical ages stand in the owned units; 少有名譽 is not a birth year.

itemChecks.event: Death of Wang Shu’s mother, attested by the mourning phrase 以母喪居郡境.
itemChecks.reason: The event owner is 王述母 (p050): 母喪 names her own death, not a descendant’s later commemoration. The source date text 以母喪居郡境 has no ruler, era, or year, so the death year is unresolved in chapter 80. The westernBounds onOrBefore AD 354 is not that death’s date; it is a ceiling borrowed from Wang Shu’s later 揚州刺史 appointment (owner: p049). This chapter never dates that appointment: s0156 is only 及述為揚州刺史. Context rows that write 永和十年 on s0156 are previous-model assertions, not independent evidence. 晉書穆帝紀 does record 永和十年二月 以前会稽内史王述为扬州刺史, and 王述傳 has 母憂去職。服闋，代殷浩為揚州刺史, so a one-sided ceiling after completed mourning is historically discussable. 東晉穆帝永和十年 is the conventional AD 354 year (永和元年 = 345; the same Wikipedia table that gives 永和九年 as 353 implies 十年 as 354). Conventional regnal-year labels need not equal the Gregorian year of every month, and this death has no month/day to normalize to proleptic Gregorian. Academia Sinica’s converter defaults to Julian before 1582, but a year-precision bound is not a Julian day claim. None of that licenses leaving a guessed AD 354 endpoint on evidence [s0153] without unresolved:true. onOrBefore would be the right bound type if a cited primary passage dated the later appointment; the present row invents the endpoint. 如此者累年 (s0155) and 服闋 also warn against treating 354 as a year she could still occupy, but the repair must not invent a tighter exact year either.

Wang Shu’s owned attestation (claim-373) correctly stays undated: rivalry (s0152), mourning succession (s0153), Yang appointment (s0156), and later audit are sequenced but not yeared in this chapter. 少有名譽 is not a birth year. Context items claim-377 and claim-968 assign 永和十年 / AD 354 to s0156, yet the sealed Chinese is only 及述為揚州刺史. hints-p049 therefore repeats an unsupported year as if it were Wang Shu’s own chapter-dated event. 晉書穆帝紀 can date the appointment to 永和十年二月, and 東晉穆帝永和十年 is conventionally AD 354, but that year is the appointment’s label, not a window of activity across the dynasty and not evidence already present in s0152–s0154. s0155 如此者累年 shows the Kuaiji waiting lasted more than one year before the appointment, so even a repaired 354 belongs only to the Yang post. The person record is incoherent while the active hint holds AD 354 without a chapter source date.

personChecks.reason: The mother has a supported already-dead attestation (claim-386) and empty active hints, which correctly keep her out of living activity. The death row (claim-387) is her own event (母喪), but its onOrBefore AD 354 endpoint is not justified from chapter 80. No owned or context unit quotes a year beside 以母喪居郡境. The 354 ceiling is Wang Shu’s later appointment, undated here and only externally placed in 永和十年 by 穆帝紀. Using that later office as a silent Gregorian bound, and treating context 永和十年 on s0156 as if it were Chinese evidence, makes the person’s chronology incoherent. Keep the death; do not convert the bound into an exact death year; do not create an active hint from it.

findings.problem: Chapter 80 attests Wang Shu’s mother’s death only as 以母喪居郡境 and his Yang appointment only as 及述為揚州刺史. Neither unit contains 永和十年. claim-387 nevertheless sets westernBounds onOrBefore AD 354, and hints-p049 stores AD 354 as Wang Shu’s active year. That year is not the mother’s event; it is the conventional label of Wang Shu’s later appointment, imported from previous-model context rows that mis-attach 永和十年 to s0156.
findings.action: Keep claim-386 and the death event on claim-387 with sourceDate 以母喪居郡境. Remove the AD 354 westernBounds or set unresolved:true with a reason that this chapter does not year the death. If a one-sided ceiling is restored, cite 晉書穆帝紀 永和十年二月 以前会稽内史王述为扬州刺史 (and 王述傳 母憂去職。服闋，代殷浩為揚州刺史), name 東晉 / 晉穆帝 / 永和十年 as conventional AD 354, keep onOrBefore rather than an exact death year, and do not invent a tighter endpoint from 累年 or 服闋. Clear hints-p049 to [] unless a repaired p049 office claim cites that annals passage; never copy 354 onto p050 as an active hint.
